skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Justice Maker
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Justice Maker. Attire of Wild Mane during repairs of 'Justice Knight.' Cozy and breathable, while wear and stain resistant. Detailing and accessories in contrasting colors coordinated to embody that sense of planning.
skins.usage: One of Wild Mane's casual outfits.
skins.quote: Be it the remodeling of her 'Justice Knight' or the future of her Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, she's overflowing with confidence.
